description: "A Sketch of the Life of the Late Henry Cooper" by William Cooper is a biographical account written in the mid-19th century. The narrative focuses on the life of Henry Cooper, a barrister, and his father, Charles Cooper, both of whom were well-respected figures in the legal profession in Norwich.
